+proj=pipeline +step +proj=unitconvert +t_in=mjd
+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs
0 0
EOF

pj_param (P->ctx, P->params, \"st_in\").s) != NULL) {","role":"source","note":"The input projection string contains +t_in=mjd, so the unitconvert initializer reads an input-controlled time input unit name."},{"step":2,"file":"src/PJ_unitconvert.c","function":"PROJECTION(unitconvert)","line":390,"var":"Q->t_in_id","code":"Q->t_in_id = i;","role":"intermediate","note":"The matched +t_in value is stored as a nonnegative time-unit index in the projection opaque state."},{"step":3,"file":"src/PJ_unitconvert.c","function":"PROJECTION(unitconvert)","line":346,"var":"Q->t_out_id","code":"Q->t_out_id = -1;","role":"root_cause","note":"Because the input omits +t_out, the output time-unit index remains the sentinel -1; reverse conversion should require Q->t_out_id >= 0 before using it."},{"step":4,"file":"src/PJ_pipeline.c","function":"pipeline_reverse_obs","line":222,"var":"P->opaque->pipeline[i]","code":"point = proj_trans_obs (P->opaque->pipeline[i], PJ_INV, point);","role":"intermediate","note":"Using the pipeline as the source projection in pj_transform drives inverse observation conversion for the unitconvert step."},{"step":5,"file":"src/PJ_unitconvert.c","function":"reverse_obs","line":315,"var":"time_units[Q->t_out_id]","code":"out.coo.xyzt.t = time_units[Q->t_out_id].t_in( obs.coo.xyzt.t );","role":"sink","note":"The guard checks Q->t_in_id but indexes time_units with Q->t_out_id, so the omitted +t_out leaves index -1 and causes an out-of-bounds array
